analysis.investment_thesis: Blue Dart is India's premium express logistics brand with a 9.3% revenue CAGR and genuine network moat backed by DHL parentage, but net profit has compounded at a paltry 2.8% over nine years and has been on a declining trajectory since FY2022 (382→371→301→252 Cr) — at 44x trailing P/E, investors are paying a premium multiple for a deteriorating earnings trend. The business is good; the price is not.
key_strengths: Premium brand moat in time-definite express delivery; DHL parentage provides global network and operational depth
OCF positive all five years, with FCF averaging INR 500+ Cr — underlying cash generation is solid
E-commerce and pharma logistics provide secular demand tailwinds for domestic express freight
key_risks: Net profit declining for three consecutive years: FY2022 382 Cr → FY2025 252 Cr, a 34% cumulative fall
Debt of INR 1,081 Cr (largely lease liabilities) combined with declining profitability pressures ROE
Intense competition from Delhivery, Xpressbees, and Amazon logistics is compressing volumes and yields
red_flags: EBITDA trend is 'contracting' per the data — a logistics business losing margin despite rising volumes is a structural concern
44x P/E on declining earnings is mispriced; even at a fair 25-28x, the stock is overvalued
Net profit of INR 252 Cr in FY2025 is essentially the same as a decade ago despite revenue more than doubling
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Blue Dart has a real competitive moat — the brand, aircraft fleet, and network took decades to build, and DHL's global ecosystem strengthens it. I respect those qualities. But I am looking at a business where revenue grew 123% over nine years while net profit grew only 28%, meaning every rupee of incremental revenue has produced negligible additional profit. That is a margin erosion story, not a compounding story.

At 44x trailing P/E for declining earnings, the market is extrapolating a recovery that the numbers have not yet validated. I would be genuinely interested at 25x or lower — that would imply a price around INR 3,000-3,200, roughly 40% below current levels. The brand and network are worth owning; the current price is not worth paying.
